messages:
Olivia: FYI customer 'BrightPages' invoice shows 0 embed units for Nov 1-3 despite high activity. I think ingest pipeline dropped events.
Maria: Can you paste query/ids? we'll need invoice id and sample user IDs.
Olivia: invoice #INV-2026-129, customer_id=cp_brightpages
Olivia: Query I ran:
```
SELECT count(*) FROM embedding_events WHERE customer_id='cp_brightpages' AND ts >= '2026-11-01' AND ts < '2026-11-04';
-- returned 0
```
Sam T.: Hmm our edge-ingest forwarded payloads but the metering lambda ack timed out around Nov 1 02:14 UTC. There's a gap in kafka partition 7.
Chen (Eng): I see offsets jump in partition 7 between 1643256 -> 1644000. Looks like a connector restart dropped ~44k messages. Logs:
```
kafka-connect-1 | WARN Connector terminated: java.lang.OutOfMemoryError
```
billing-bot: alert: metering-backfill-needed for customer cp_brightpages, missing 44,312 embed events. ticket: FIN-7421
Maria: Ok, we need an accuracy check before any billing adjustment. Sam, can finance-eng produce an estimated billable embed count with sampling? Also need approval for backfill which will re-ingest events into metering.
Sam T.: I'll run a sampled recount and produce CSV with event ids + token counts. ETA 2h. plan: replay from kafka offsets 1643257..1644000 into metering-staging then run reconciliation.
Olivia: We need to ensure rate-limit credits weren't double-counted when we reprocess. Also confirm any retries that were already charged.
Sam T.: Good point. We'll exclude any request_id already present in billable_index. Reprocess job will tag source='replay-2026-11-01-kconn' so we can filter.
Eli (Dir Finance): Approve tentative backfill if engineering can prove net delta and we produce a credit memo for any overcharges. Need signoff on estimated delta before actual run.
Sam T.: Understood. I'll attach CSV and delta calc when ready. Also asking eng-ml for token normalization check.
Ava (Eng-ML): Tokenization difference minimal; use bytepair v2 normalization. No quality impact.
Olivia: Thanks. Please don't run on prod metering yet — use staging and LM's approval. Also need emails to customer legal.
Maria: Adding to FIN board. tagging @legal @fp-audit
Sam T.: Uploading sample CSV now: https://files.redwood/fin/samples/FIN-7421-sample.csv
Sam T.: Reconcile results: estimated billable embeds = 44,312 -> cost delta $1,328.20. Proposed actions: (1) issue credit $1,328.20, (2) run staged backfill for completeness, (3) no invoice change unless customer disputes.
Eli (Dir Finance): Approve credit and backfill. Maria, please prep credit memo. Olivia, coordinate comms.
Olivia: Will draft email and legal loop. Thx all :thumbsup:
